findings.reason: a worker dispatched on §3 would rule the bar from the 51.3 % either-reader figure the plan itself says is biased, and §4 would carry the rejected readers into every group audit, so the bar and the group readings both rest on an instrument the plan's own record has disqualified.
findings.text: §3 says "The bar here is fixed once, from what §1 measures", while §1's own close comment says the readers caught only 45 %/55 % of the known-defective plants and flagged 25 % of the known-sound ones and that "a bar fixed from them would carry that error", and the committed lead ruling of 2026-11-17 (`docs/evidence/fragments/sn-audited-group-release/briefs/frontier-third-reader.md:3`, commit 757626386) states the two readers are "too weak to fix a release bar from" and adds a frontier third reader for that purpose; §4:41 then fixes "the same two readers" as the readers for every group audit

findings.reason: the worker must either report a rate over the changed subset and fail §3's precondition at the cut, or re-read the whole group and contradict §4's own sentence, and nothing in the plan chooses between them.
findings.text: §4 fixes "the group's rate after repair is that second reading", where that second reading covers "every member whose stored text changed", while §3:37 refuses any cut whose group rate "was never measured over every member"; for a group that leaves any member unchanged the two conditions cannot both hold

findings.reason: the gate as written enforces the aggregate and leaves every per-class maximum unenforced, which is the distinction the bar was defined around.
findings.text: the bar is defined as "the largest audited defect rate a group may carry, per defect class where the classes differ in consequence", but the refusal clause tests only "the group's audited defect rate", the any-class rate §1 reports as its headline figure, so a group whose aggregate is under the bar passes with one class arbitrarily high

findings.reason: the plan text prescribes no file name and the review is of the plan's content, so renaming the evidence page changes no decision the plan makes.
findings.text: the audit evidence page, and the `sagr-frontier-third-reader.html` page the pending brief plans, encode the plan slug `sn-audited-group-release` as `sagr`, a name that means nothing outside this plan's tracker entry
